tail:
Completed batch 3’s draft authoring and evidence; published pages and carriers remain unchanged.

### Drafts and evidence

- Added a Euclidean \(C^1\) critical-locus definition, including the zero-dimensional source case, and a complete proof of a \(C^1\) map whose critical values contain \([0,2]\): [definition](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-c1-critical-locus-and-critical-value-set-in-euclidean-spaces.md>), [witness lemma](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-a-c1-map-from-r2-to-r-with-an-interval-of-critical-values.md>).
- Updated the [batch manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-3.pages.json>) to 48 A items and 10 B items. Recomputed levels: maximum 8, no cycles. Cross-batch dependencies are empty.
- Recorded source locators, dispositions and fetch stamps in the [coverage file](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-3.coverage.json>). Lang’s §9.2 was added for the finite-\(C^r\) threshold; it states the threshold and gives the smooth proof route, while the local carrier supplies its own finite-\(C^r\) argument. [Urs Lang, *Differential Geometry I*](https://people.math.ethz.ch/~lang/DG1_7Oct2024.pdf)
- Strict proof contracts pass for all 48 proof-bearing items. See the [contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-3.proof-contracts.json>) and [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-3.notes.md>).

### Checks and handoff blockers

Precheck passed 48/48; proof layout passed for both drafts with five steps and zero defects; render check passed 2/2; scoped dependency check had zero errors; content policy passed with zero errors or warnings; source fetch verified 5/5.

The published Sard false-statement and counterexample carriers still lack their arguments. The finite-\(C^r\) Morse–Sard theorem also depends on a smooth-only critical-locus definition. These repairs are recorded for the owner. The two new drafts are listed on the A manifest but are not integrated into the published page.

No batch-3 Step 1 records were written: the readiness tool stops on a duplicate item in batches 21 and 22. Whole-run proof-contract coverage also stops on missing item `def-finite-alphabet-stationary-source` in batch 10. Both blockers are documented in the notes.
